newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed, Totta slides - 23 Jan.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed, Totta slides - 23 Jan.

text.p: Shares ended mixed with the firmer tone in New York accounting as a counter-weight to Banco Totta which continued to slide.
*Dealers said that the selling of Banco Totta, triggered by worse than expected 1996 results, may not be over and that the stock could continue to pressure the market on Friday.
*The .PSI20 index ended 0.10 percent down at 5,729.76 in overall bourse trade of 7.7 billion escudos.
*The better tone to Wall Street helped push Portugal Telecom and Sonae Investimentos.
*"The rest of the market could be influenced by BTA but shares which are most exposed to non-resident investment will be affected what happens elsewhere," said one trader.
